submissions.title: Data center moratorium takes first steps after Fort Worth City Council's unanimous vote
submissions.excerpt: City Council voted unanimously to begin the process for a 90-day moratorium on new data center construction
submissions.note: SITING RESTRICTION: Fort Worth, TX City Council voted unanimously on Aug 11, 2026 to start the legal process toward a 90-day construction moratorium on data centers (earliest possible effective date Feb 16, 2027) and created a Data Center & Infrastructure Commission chaired by TCU's Dr. Mike Slattery. Council also passed (10-1) an ordinance requiring new data-center applicants to show PUCT/ERCOT grid-connection approval before filing. No specific tracked project named in coverage found.
